|errata_history=Versions of [[Frustration (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): first release sheet “Virtual Set #7” (Players Committee; set released 16 July 2004; PDF dated 17 July 2004), page 2, slip 15 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20040730074404/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualCards7.pdf VirtualCards7.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 30 July 2004), linked from the [https://web.archive.org/web/20040922081946/http://swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's home page]: “USED: If Vengeance Of The Dark Prince on table and you just peeked at or revealed cards in your Life Force, reorder the top 3 cards however you wish (you may then take the top card into hand). LOST: If Xizor and Guri are in a battle together, add 5 to your total battle destiny and retrieve the bottom card of your Lost Pile into your hand.” The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “7•15” at bottom right and no expansion icon. The updated sheet of 12 October 2004 (“Updated 10/12/04”; [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205104319/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%207.pdf Virtual Set 7.pdf], Internet Archive 5 December 2004) prints the same words on the same old slip ([[:File:OVS7-15-Frustration-original-slip-2004-10-12.png]]).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Frustration (V) (Virtual Set 7) (Errata)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143103/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards7.pdf Internet Archive capture of 26 October 2007], slip 15), in the Committee's Remaster template: “USED: If you just peeked at cards in your Life Force, peek at and reorder the top 3 cards of that deck or pile (may take one into hand). LOST: If Xizor and Guri are in a battle together, your total battle destiny is +5 and may retrieve 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
